title: Desk posture
summary: A short daily break from sitting, five to ten minutes: a desk reset, then upper back, hip flexor and neck movement.
honesty: This is general movement for people who sit a lot. It makes no claims about pain or injury. If you have pain, numbness or tingling, see a qualified professional.

weeks.focus: Just the five-minute desk reset, every day
Add an upper-back move and a hip flexor hold
Ongoing: the reset plus upper back, hips and neck
